footnote_text: Represents fully vested restricted stock units granted to the reporting person on October 21, 2026 under the ProCap Financial, Inc. 2025 Equity Incentive Plan pursuant to the Mutual Separation Agreement and General Release, dated October 20, 2026, between the reporting person and the Issuer. The amount reported is the gross number of shares, before any shares withheld or sold in connection with tax obligations.

Represents shares of Common Stock withheld by the Issuer to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the award reported on the preceding line. The price reported is the fair market value per share on the transaction date used to determine the withholding.

Represents shares of Common Stock withheld by the Issuer to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting on October 21, 2026 of 157,442 restricted stock units previously granted to the reporting person under the ProCap Financial, Inc. 2025 Equity Incentive Plan, which were included in the reporting person's previously reported holdings. The price reported is the fair market value per share on the transaction date used to determine the withholding.
